title: add-rag-cicd-playbook-and-typed-adapters
author: Maya Singh
release_notes: Introduce a RAG CI/CD playbook with typed tool adapters and Playwright-based integration smoke tests. No breaking API changes. Adds examples and docs for onboarding CI for retrieval-augmented workflows.
description:
Context and motivation: Teams shipping retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) features often struggle to get consistent CI coverage that validates both retrieval correctness and tool-calling integrations. This PR adds a compact CI/CD playbook and example pipeline that demonstrates recommended guardrails: deterministic indexing, integration tests that exercise tool bindings, and stepwise smoke checks for model/cost regressions. The quickstart is intentionally small (single-index, mock vector store) and opinionated: it codifies an observable test surface for RAG features that platform engineers can copy into their org repos.

What this PR includes (summary): - A curated CI playbook and GitHub Actions workflows that run fast smoke tests and slower nightly full-path e2e tests. - Typed adapter examples (TypeScript) for tool-calling and vector store bindings with runtime contracts and example fixtures. - Playwright-based browser harness that validates the full tool-calling flow (chat -> retrieval -> tool call -> structured response). - An indexed dev fixture generator (seed corpus + deterministic tokenizer config) for reproducible tests. - Docs: a step-by-step onboarding guide under quickstarts/rag-cicd-playbook/README.md, and a checklist for integrating the playbook into existing repos.

Checklist (implemented): [x] Add quickstart directory with README and example pipeline YAML [x] Provide typed adapters for tool bindings (TS) with JSDoc and tests [x] Add Playwright smoke tests that run in CI container [x] Add nightly workflow template for full-run e2e checks [x] Document cost/time budget recommendations and SLOs [x] Add sample Linear links and test data used for evals

Commits (high level): - 3f8b6c2: initial scaffold, README and pipeline templates - a8d4e1f: typed tool adapter runtime and unit tests - d22f9b1: Playwright smoke harness and fixtures - 9b07f3c: CI workflow tweaks (cache, matrix) to reduce runtime - b5c3e20: docs polish and checklist additions

Changed files (high level): - redwood-quickstarts/rag-cicd-playbook/README.md - redwood-quickstarts/rag-cicd-playbook/.github/workflows/ci-smoke.yml - redwood-quickstarts/rag-cicd-playbook/.github/workflows/nightly-e2e.yml - redwood-quickstarts/rag-cicd-playbook/adapters/typed-adapter.ts - redwood-quickstarts/rag-cicd-playbook/adapters/__tests__/adapter.spec.ts - redwood-quickstarts/rag-cicd-playbook/playwright/stepper.spec.ts - redwood-quickstarts/rag-cicd-playbook/fixtures/seed-corpus.json - redwood-quickstarts/rag-cicd-playbook/scripts/build-fixtures.js - docs/quickstarts/rag-cicd-playbook/onboarding.md

Testing notes: Local runs: npm run test:unit (fast) and npm run test:smoke (requires Playwright, runs headless). In CI the smoke job has a 15 minute walltime budget and uses a cached index to avoid repeated tokenization costs. Nightly job runs in a larger runner and exercises uploads to a real (configurable) vector store endpoint behind feature flags.

Review summary & convo: "Liam O'Connor": "Nice pattern for CI. Two asks: (1) make the Playwright tests resilient to small timing jitter; (2) add a short example for how to fold this into a monorepo where the model runtime is in a different package." "Maya Singh": "Addressed both: added retry helpers in playwright utils and documented monorepo integration in onboarding.md (see commit b5c3e20)." "Zara Patel": "Please add a short note about cost guardrails and how to skip nightly runs in low-usage orgs." "Maya Singh": "Added cost/time budget section and workflow input to skip nightly runs." "Noah Rivera": "Left a minor nit on test fixture naming — prefixed with stable- to indicate determinism." "Maya Singh": "Renamed fixtures accordingly and updated references."

CI history: First CI run failed on Playwright flakiness (timeout). I increased timeouts and added a retry wrapper; green on second run. Lint and unit tests passed on first run. Nightly workflow validated separately.

Merge outcome: Merged via squash (merge method: squash), commit message consolidated to "quickstart(rag): add cicd playbook, typed adapters, and playwright smoke tests".

How to use / next steps: - Copy redwood-quickstarts/rag-cicd-playbook into your repo and follow onboarding.md for integration steps. - Replace the seed-corpus.json with your domain documents and adjust tokenizer settings for reproducible indices. - If you run on Redwood Hosted, flip the vector-store-config to the official connector and enable the nightly workflow under your org settings.

Related: Linear ENG-2145 describes the broader plan for RAG observability in CI; see PM-098 for the product checklist.

Notes for maintainers: Keep the Playwright jobs minimal — they are intended as smoke/signalling checks, not full functional tests. The adapter examples are intentionally lightweight; they are opinionated building blocks, not production SDK replacements.
